# ICE WIND

> ICE WIND is the public brand of ICEWIND DALE CONSULTING LTD, a web development
> studio in London. We design and build websites, web and mobile applications,
> AI systems, automation and games, and we consult on every service we deliver.

Registered in England and Wales, company number 15925349. ICO registration ZB838524.
Registered office: 178-188 Kensington High Street, 28 Stafford Court, London, W8 7DL.
Contact: manager@icewinddaleconsulting.com

## Services

- [Web design](https://www.icewinddaleconsulting.com/web-design/): interface and visual design, wireframes and prototypes, redesigns, design delivered on its own or built by us.
- [Web development](https://www.icewinddaleconsulting.com/web-development/): marketing and content sites, e-commerce, rebuilds and modernisation, post-launch support.
- [Web app development](https://www.icewinddaleconsulting.com/web-app-development/): products people sign in to and use — MVPs, internal tools, replacing spreadsheet processes, API integrations.
- [Mobile app development](https://www.icewinddaleconsulting.com/mobile-app-development/): iOS and Android applications, native or cross-platform depending on the project.
- [Game development](https://www.icewinddaleconsulting.com/game-development/): casual 2D, browser and HTML5 games, Telegram Mini App games, prototypes, leaderboards and game backends.
- [AI automation](https://www.icewinddaleconsulting.com/ai-automation/): workflow automation, AI assistants, document processing, CRM and system integrations, with human review where judgement matters.
- [AI consultancy](https://www.icewinddaleconsulting.com/ai-consulting/): opportunity audits, use-case selection, model and vendor choice, data readiness, roadmaps. Deciding what to build, as distinct from building it.
- [SEO](https://www.icewinddaleconsulting.com/seo/): technical SEO, keyword research, on-page optimisation, Core Web Vitals, structured data, reporting.
- [Local SEO](https://www.icewinddaleconsulting.com/local-seo/): Google Business Profile, map-pack visibility, local relevance and citations.
- [AI search optimisation](https://www.icewinddaleconsulting.com/ai-search-optimisation/): generative engine optimisation — being understood, cited and recommended in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.
- [Website redesign](https://www.icewinddaleconsulting.com/website-redesign/): rebuilding an existing site without losing search visibility.
- [Small business web design](https://www.icewinddaleconsulting.com/small-business-web-design/): focused websites for smaller budgets and shorter page lists.

## Work

- [Case studies](https://www.icewinddaleconsulting.com/work/)
- [Barsion](https://www.icewinddaleconsulting.com/work/barsion/): bilingual site rebuild; first contentful paint went from 7.7s to under 0.5s, network requests from 90 to 12, third-party requests to zero.
- [Lamar Academy](https://www.icewinddaleconsulting.com/work/lamar-academy/): Mayfair medical aesthetics clinic and training academy, two audiences on one site.
- [GameFoundry](https://www.icewinddaleconsulting.com/work/gamefoundry/): in-house games marketplace with user-uploaded playable builds, sandboxed execution, ratings and leaderboards.
